text: God's purpose for me will not be cancelled — His love makes sure of it.
bibleVerseText: The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me; your steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever.

text: My steps are held firm by God — even my wrong turns are in His hands.
bibleVerseText: The Lord makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him.

text: I am God's masterpiece — made with intention, not by accident.
bibleVerseText: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

text: Nothing in my story is wasted — God works even the worst parts for good.
bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

text: God called my name and the prize He set for me is still there.
bibleVerseText: I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.

text: God chose me — I didn't have to earn it, and I can't lose it.
bibleVerseText: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit—fruit that will last.

text: Every day of my life was written by God before I took my first breath.
bibleVerseText: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

text: I am here — in this exact moment — because God placed me here on purpose.
bibleVerseText: And who knows but that you have come to your royal position for such a time as this?

text: God knew me before I was born and set me apart before I could fail.
bibleVerseText: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart.

text: The land God promised me is still there — no detour erased my inheritance.
bibleVerseText: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

text: God placed an open door before me that no failure can ever close.
bibleVerseText: See, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut.

text: God started His work in me and He does not leave things unfinished.
bibleVerseText: Being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

text: God put His own mind in me — I am not stumbling through this blind.
bibleVerseText: But we have the mind of Christ.

text: God is doing a new thing in me right now — the past is not my ending.
bibleVerseText: Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing!

text: My life carries a light meant for more people than I can count right now.
bibleVerseText: I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that my salvation may reach to the ends of the earth.

text: The Spirit of God is on me — I was anointed for this before I understood it.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.

text: What God put inside me is already making room for where I'm supposed to be.
bibleVerseText: A gift opens the way and ushers the giver into the presence of the great.

text: God gave me understanding for this season — I know what this moment is calling for.
bibleVerseText: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do.

text: I can do everything God called me to do — His strength in me makes it possible.
bibleVerseText: I can do all this through him who gives me strength.

text: I cannot be hidden — God built me to shine and my purpose will not stay buried.
bibleVerseText: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

text: God prepared my purpose before I was born — I just walk into what He already built.
bibleVerseText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

text: My race is not over. The One who gave it knows every mile still ahead.
bibleVerseText: I consider my life worth nothing to me; my only aim is to finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me.

text: God's purpose for me is guaranteed by His love — and His love never runs out.
bibleVerseText: The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me; your steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever.

text: What God promised me is coming — the waiting is not a sign He forgot.
bibleVerseText: Though it linger, wait for it; it will certainly come and will not delay.

text: God lights the next step for me — I don't need to see the whole road.
bibleVerseText: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

text: Every chapter of my story — even the ones I'd delete — is being written for good.
bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

text: God set a prize for me that my failures cannot cancel and death cannot steal.
bibleVerseText: I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.

text: God chose me to bear fruit that lasts — my life reaches further than I can see.
bibleVerseText: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit — fruit that will last.

text: God opened a door for me that no person, no mistake, no season can close.
bibleVerseText: See, I have placed before you an open door that no one can shut.

text: Even my uncertain steps are ordered by God — I cannot wander outside His plan.
bibleVerseText: The Lord makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him.

text: God's anointing is on me now — it was placed before my failures tried to remove it.
bibleVerseText: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me, because the Lord has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor.

text: God knew me fully before I was born — and still chose me. That hasn't changed.
bibleVerseText: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart.

text: God's plans for me are specific and already written — not a general wish, a real promise.
bibleVerseText: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

text: God makes everything beautiful in its time — including this chapter I don't understand yet.
bibleVerseText: He has made everything beautiful in its time.

text: Where shame tried to write my ending, God is writing a double portion of honor.
bibleVerseText: Instead of your shame you will receive a double portion, and instead of disgrace you will rejoice in your inheritance.
